### Jesus Makes Room for Women
Author: Jen Oshman
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/encouragement-for-today-july-8-2026.html
Passage: Luke 8:1-2
Points:
- Women frequently wrestle with self-doubt and question whether they have a welcome place in ministry.
- Jesus defied the social norms of His day by welcoming women to travel, learn, and serve alongside Him.
- Mary Magdalene, Joanna, and others experienced His healing and actively financed His gospel mission.
- Christ demonstrates that women are never an afterthought, but an intentional priority in God's kingdom.

### Many Generous Women
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/many-generous-women
Passage: Luke 8:1-3
Points:
- Because Jesus owned no earthly property, His itinerant ministry relied on the material generosity of others.
- Welcoming female disciples was culturally countercultural, as rabbis rarely taught women in that era.
- Women of diverse backgrounds, from court officials' wives to the formerly afflicted, were united in Christ.
- Having received God's grace, believers are called to faithfully support those engaged in full-time gospel work.
